A.instruction: Reject all pending Venmo payment requests from my friends and roommates.

steps.code:
venmo_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "venmo")
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='connorbrow@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)
print(venmo_login)
venmo_access_token = venmo_login["access_token"]

pending_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        status='pending',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    print(f"Page {page_index}: {len(page)} requests")
    if not page:
        break
    pending_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total pending requests: {len(pending_requests)}")
for req in pending_requests:
    print(req["payment_request_id"], req["sender"]["name"], req["sender"]["email"], req["amount"])
